question: What happened to Bahadur Shah II after the fall of Delhi?
answer: Bahadur Shah II, King of Delhi, was eighty-two years old [7]. He was a pensioner of the British [8] and lived in his palace in Delhi [9]. The mutineers surprised him when they arrived [9]. After the mutiny, he was reduced [8]. He was also a member of his court who became a Christian [7]. [13]

question: Which act transferred rule of India from the East India Company to the Crown?
answer: The 1773 Regulating Act made the Company responsible for governing the territories it controlled [7]. The 1784 India Act brought the Company more firmly under the control of the British Government [7]. In 1858, the East India Company was abolished and the British Government ruled India directly [8]. [8][1]
